The national quality indicators for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) in Denmark, as reported by the [[styregruppen-for-danibd|Styregruppen for DANIBD]], reveal significant disparities in the fulfillment of clinical standards across the 2023 to 2025 reporting periods [^src1]. The comprehensive overview of aggregated indicator results highlights both consistent successes and persistent systemic shortcomings in patient care and monitoring [^src1].

In the 2025 reporting year, the clear leaders in quality assurance are [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] and [[indikator-7|Indikator 7]]. [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]], which tracks the annual measurement of fecal calprotectin for patients on biologic and targeted synthetic disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (BMSL), achieved a high score of 86%, comfortably exceeding the 80% target [^src1]. This represents a steady upward trend from 79% in 2023 to 83% in 2024, and 86% in 2025 [^src1]. Similarly, [[indikator-7|Indikator 7]], monitoring colonoscopies for adults with primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) within 18 months, scored 82% in 2025, successfully meeting its ≥80% threshold, despite minor fluctuations from 84% in 2023 and 80% in 2024 [^src1]. [[indikator-1a|Indikator 1a]] also managed to meet its target in 2025, reaching exactly 80% for relevant diagnostic workups in newly diagnosed adults, a slight improvement from 79% in 2024 [^src1].

Conversely, several indicators act as trailers, falling drastically short of their developmental goals. The most alarming outlier is [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which measures the proportion of newly diagnosed patients receiving education within one year of diagnosis [^src1]. Scoring a mere 26% in 2025, it remains profoundly below the 80% target, even though it doubled from a baseline of 13% in 2024 [^src1]. [[indikator-4|Indikator 4]] is another significant trailer; only 36% of IBD patients over 50 receiving steroid courses underwent the required DEXA scanning for bone density, missing the 80% target and remaining virtually flat compared to 37% in 2024 [^src1]. [[indikator-1b|Indikator 1b]] also missed its target, declining from 70% in 2024 to 66% in 2025 for diagnostic workups in children and adolescents [^src1]. [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] (colonoscopy within a year of ileocecal resection) scored 64%, missing the 80% goal and showing a slight decline from 65% in 2024 [^src1].

Finally, [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] operates on an inverse target, aiming for a reoperation rate of ≤8% within 30 days of surgery [^src1]. The 2025 result of 10% indicates a missed target, though it shows improvement from a peak of 13% in 2024 and 11% in 2023 [^src1]. Overall, while biological monitoring and specific cancer-surveillance colonoscopies show robust compliance, structural elements of patient care—such as patient education, pediatric diagnostics, and osteoporosis prevention—suffer from severe and persistent implementation gaps [^src1].

## Table: DANIBD_2025.pdf, p. 10

Rows compare: indikator · Columns show: årsrapport og indikatoropfyldelse

| Indikator | Udviklingsmål | Årsrapport 2025 | Årsrapport 2024 | Årsrapport 2023 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Indikator 1a: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede voksne med IBD, der har fået foretaget relevant udredning | ≥ 80 | 80 (78-81) | 79 | — |
| Indikator 1b: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede børn og unge med IBD, der har fået foretaget relevant udredning | ≥ 80 | 66 (59-73) | 70 | — |
| Indikator 2: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med IBD, der har modtaget undervisning inden for ét år efter diagnosen er stillet | ≥ 80 | 26 (24-27) | 13 | — |
| Indikator 3: Andelen af voksne med Crohns sygdom, der har fået foretaget ileocækal resektion, som bliver koloskoperet inden for ét år efter operationen | ≥ 80 | 64 (55-71) | 65 | — |
| Indikator 4: Andelen af steroidkurer givet til patienter over 50 år med IBD, hvor patienten har fået foretaget DEXA-scanning | ≥ 80 | 36 (33-39) | 37 | — |
| Indikator 5: Andelen af patienter med IBD i behandling med BMSL, der får målt F-calpro mindst én gang årligt | ≥ 80 | 86 (85-86) | 83 | 79 |
| Indikator 6: Andelen af kirurgiske indgreb, hvor der er foretaget en reoperation inden for 30 dage | ≤ 8 | 10 (8-12) | 13 | 11 |
| Indikator 7: Andelen af voksne med primær skleroserende kolangitis (PSC), der får foretaget koloskopi inden for 18 måneder | ≥ 80 | 82 (78-86) | 80 | 84 |

Entities: indikator-1a, indikator-1b, indikator-2, indikator-3, indikator-4, indikator-5, indikator-6, indikator-7, styregruppen-for-danibd

Summary: Tabellen viser landsdækkende indikatorresultater for 2025, og fremhæver betydelige forskelle i opfyldelse: Indikator 5 og 7 ligger over målet, mens Indikator 2 og 4 ligger langt under, hvilket signalerer store variationer i implementering af kvalitetsstandarder.
